tasks.prompt: Create a self-contained executable stdlib-only Python 3 module at playground/f2/dag/test_code_path.py. Define is_safe_relative_path(value) -> bool for POSIX workspace paths. Accept strings only, nonempty, relative, starting with playground/, filenames only (last segment must contain dot); reject absolute paths, backslashes, NUL, empty/dot/dotdot segments and hidden components. Include unittest.TestCase with >=5 positive/negative tests, runnable with python3 -m unittest discover -s playground/f2/dag -p test_code_path.py. Never read/write any file, run commands, import other modules from playground, or modify other paths. Pure stdlib only.

Create self-contained stdlib-only Python 3 module playground/f2/dag/test_code_digest.py. Define verify_sha256(data, expected_hex) -> bool; accept bytes and only 64 lowercase hex chars for expected_hex, compute SHA-256 and use hmac.compare_digest on 64-character digests. Reject nonbytes, invalid digest formats, wrong digests and bool/numeric digest. Include unittest.TestCase with >=5 tests including known hash for b"abc", wrong content, uppercase digest, malformed digest, wrong type. No network/IO/subprocess, modify only this file.

Write self-contained stdlib Python3 module playground/f2/dag/test_code_json.py. Define parse_strict_object(raw: str, allowed_keys: frozenset[str]) -> dict that parses a strict JSON object; reject duplicate keys (object_pairs_hook), reject NaN/Infinity (parse_constant), reject root list/scalar, unknown keys, non-string input, and excessively long text (>8192 chars). Raise ValueError on rejected input, accept valid empty dictionary. Include unittest.TestCase with >=6 positive/negative tests, no network/file IO, do not touch other files.

Write stdlib-only Python3 module playground/f2/dag/test_code_run.py. Define matches_run_identity(receipt, run_id, run_attempt, head_sha) -> bool. Expected receipt dictionary fields exactly run_id, run_attempt, head_sha; require int not bool run_id>0 and attempt>0, 40-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA, and exact equality with supplied expected values; reject missing/extra fields, bools/floats, uppercase hex, SHA mismatch, attempt mismatch and wrong inputs by returning False. Include unittest.TestCase with >=6 tests, no filesystem/network/subprocess and modify only this file.

Write stdlib-only Python3 module playground/f2/dag/test_code_owner.py. Define scopes_disjoint(scopes: dict[str, list[str]]) -> bool. Accept mapping nonempty task IDs to nonempty path lists, reject non-string paths, absolute paths, backslashes, empty/dot/dotdot segments and any case-insensitive duplicate path across or within tasks. Reject nested collisions e.g. playground/a and playground/a/b. Valid distinct POSIX-relative playground/ file paths should pass. Include unittest.TestCase with >=6 positive/negative tests including cross-agent collision, casefold duplicates, traversal, malformed containers. Pure stdlib, no network/IO/subprocess, only own file.
